services.name: Snorkel Island Adventure
services.desc: We provide complimentary snorkel supplies and transportation to the island on our Sand Island Adventure! Spend part of your day on Orange Beach's popular back bay pristine Sand Island sandbars. Snorkel, swim, or put your toes in the water and relax. Make a Tik-Tok! It's so much fun! Unlike the round tikis, this boat has a private restroom on board. 3 Hours Please Note: Passengers under 12 must have a parent or guardian present at check 3 Hours • All Ages • Starts at $48

services.name: Pirate and Princess boat ride.
services.desc: Princess and Pirate themed boat rides! 55 Minutes About This boat ride is Instagram worthy for numerous photo opps. Bring your favorite beverage and take a relaxing affordable boat ride around the islands and back bays of Orange Beach. This specific tour does NOT guarantee dolphin sightings although most of the time we see dolphins on this ride. Fun music and themed, and beautiful back bay and island All Ages • 60 minutes

services.name: Pontoon Boat rental with Captain
services.desc: 2 Hours About Have you ever wondered how to get to the Island that you see when your family crosses the big bridge in Orange Beach? It is only accessible by boat and we can take you there. Have you heard of Pirate’s Cove? It just happens to be the place that sells the famous “Cheeseburger in Paradise” that our beloved Jimmy Buffet wrote and sang about. If you haven’t had a Pirate’s Cove Cheeseburger in Paradise, you don’t know what you’re missing. A private boat rental will get you around to places that can’t be accessed by land 2hr • Plus additional Hours • from 6 to 36 people (large capacity)

services.name: Daytime Dolphin Cruises
services.desc: Best Dolphin Cruise in Orange Beach and Gulf Shores that guarantees dolphins and fun. All ages • 1.5 hour

services.name: Back Bay NIGHT TIKI Cruise
services.desc: 1.25 hour About: Please note: no guarantee of dolphin sightings After the sun goes down, grab a drink, and hop on our pink tiki for a night time boat ride in the back bay to see all the pretty lights of the Orange Beach skyline and star gaze. We often do these tours on nights when a full moon is rising but we can't guarantee a moon viewing due to occasional cloud cover. We play great music- some singalong and if karaoke is your flavor, our DJ could be persuaded to give you a "mic". This is a nighttime boat ride through the back bay waters. Our dolphins are sleeping so likely no Ages 2+ • 1.25 hour

services.name: Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: Our Dolphin Cruise special - same great tour, lower price! A narrated sightseeing cruise inclusive of wild dolphin viewing, local celebrity home viewing, photo ops GALORE, and a relaxing boat ride filled with fun for all ages. Join us on our spacious boat for a relaxing comfortable ride in the calm waters of the back bay. 1.5 1.5 Hours • Most Popular!

services.name: Daily Lucky $13 Cruise!
services.desc: 1,5 hour About While we can’t give you the winning lottery ticket, we can offer you a family friendly priced Dolphin Cruise. For the price of a movie ticket, you can go out and watch these beautiful wild mammals in their natural habitat and see some gorgeous sights along the way during the boat ride. Our boat is fully covered with a Steel roof. While that absorbs a lot of heat, please dress in lightweight clothing and no denim during the hotter months. This request is for your safety and comfort. Please Note: Passengers under 12 must have a parent or guardian present at check All Ages • 1.5 h • This tour has a purchase requirement of 3 tickets minimum
